summary: LDIF user-directory mapping + differential audit-bridge with per-event HMAC and RFC3161 timestamp proof
description:
Issue summary: Customer requests an on-demand mapping and delivery configuration that joins tenant audit events to their LDAP directory (LDIF export) and produces a differential (delta) audit bridge for their SIEM. They require per-event HMAC signatures (tenant-scoped KEK), RFC3161 timestamping on daily snapshots, and a verifiable proof-of-deletion manifest for GDPR/DSAR requests.

Impact: Atlas Finance cannot reconcile user identity fields in their SIEM (SumoLogic) with Redwood audit events. They also require cryptographic evidence suitable for legal e-discovery and EU data subject deletion requests. Without this, they cannot complete an internal audit and legal compliance sign-off.

Environment: prod:us-east with cross-region replication to eu-west; customer runs a Dedicated tier connected via private peering (VPC).

Requested deliverables:
- A field map that translates LDIF attributes (dn, uid, mail, memberOf) to Redwood audit principal fields and canonical tenant_id.
- Delta/differential delivery plan (hourly patches + resume tokens) instead of full daily exports to minimize bandwidth.
- Per-event HMAC scheme description and tenant key rotation schedule (KEK/DEK separation).
- RFC3161 timestamping plan for daily snapshot manifests and instructions for verification.
- Proof-of-deletion manifest format and an operator checklist for fulfilling DSARs.

Customer-provided artifacts: sample LDIF extract (10k users), CIEM mapping spreadsheet, and their SumoLogic ingest field list.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer exported a 10k-user LDIF from their IdP and uploaded to Atlas Finance S3 staging bucket.
2) They linked Redwood audit delta stream to their SumoLogic bridge using our standard SIEM connector (connector v2.3).
3) After initial sync, customer reports mismatch: LDAP uid -> redwood.actor.id mapping inconsistent for ~2.3% of events.
4) Customer attempted manual reconciliation using timestamp and IP hints and found gaps where resume tokens advanced but payloads were duplicated in their SIEM.
5) Customer opened this ticket requesting canonical mapping and cryptographic proofs for legal review.

investigation_notes: 03-10 16:00 - Miguel: Preliminary check shows resume_token advancement is working, but dedupe window uses event.uuid and plain actor.subject string; when actor is a DN (LDIF style) canonicalization normalizes to uid only in some code paths, causing perceived duplicates.

03-11 09:12 - Engineering: Found drift between LDIF->principal normalization table and runtime canonicalizer introduced in commit 9a7f2c (bridge v3.7). Edge-case: DNs with escaped comma sequences produced different normalized uids.

03-11 11:05 - Compliance: RFC3161 stamping exists for snapshot manifests but not per-event. Proposal: daily snapshot manifests RFC3161-signed + per-event HMAC using tenant KEK with journaling for chain-of-custody.

03-11 16:50 - Ops: Created short-term replay job to rehydrate events for 2026-03-09 14:00-15:00 using stable canonicalizer and attach resume tokens; will deliver to customer S3 staging for verification.
action_items: Engineering to patch canonicalizer to consistently extract uid from LDIF DN forms (expected PR by 2026-03-12).
Ops to produce delta replays for affected hour and place verified files in customer staging S3 with HMAC and a signed manifest (ETA 2026-03-12).
Security/Compliance to document RFC3161 snapshot signing steps and provide generator/verifier scripts to customer (ETA 2026-03-13).
Support to produce an operator acceptance checklist and DSAR deletion manifest template for legal sign-off.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-12 - Engineering released patch that normalizes LDIF DNs to canonical uid. Commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/commit/9f3d2e4 (backported to bridge v3.7.1).

2026-03-12 - Ops delivered replayed delta bundle to customer staging bucket: s3://atlas-finance-redwood-staging/replays/2026-03-09/14h/. Files include per-event HMAC (sha256) and daily-manifest.rfc3161.sig
2026-03-12 - Support validated with customer on a call: Atlas reconciled previously mismatched 2.3% (now 0.0%). Customer accepted RFC3161 manifest and HMAC scheme.
Follow-up: Provide a runbook entry in Confluence for LDIF-to-principal mapping edge-cases and schedule a cross-team review for export guarantees.
